definitions.explanation: Money going out of an account or being withdrawn.

examples.japanese: ATMで{出金|しゅっきん}する。
examples.english: To withdraw money from an ATM.

examples.japanese: {出金|しゅっきん}{履歴|りれき}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{一日|いちにち}の{出金|しゅっきん}{限度額|げんどがく}は50{万|まん}{円|えん}です。
examples.english: The daily withdrawal limit is 500,000 yen.

notes:
{出金|しゅっきん} refers to money being withdrawn or going out.

CONTRAST:
- {出金|しゅっきん}: money going out (withdrawal)
- {入金|にゅうきん}: money coming in (deposit)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {出金|しゅっきん}{手数料|てすうりょう}: withdrawal fee
- {出金|しゅっきん}{限度額|げんどがく}: withdrawal limit
- {出金|しゅっきん}{履歴|りれき}: withdrawal history
